annotation_fields.rationale: The issue offers two alternatives: make W8003 also flag always-false Fn::Equals, or reword the rule to say it only detects always-true cases. Local evidence prefers the first: the rule's docstring and documented description say it validates whether Fn::Equals is comparing two strings or two equal items, its message already says 'always return True or False', and the conditions engine treats any two static strings as a static result. The code only flags identical operands, so the target is to also flag differing static literals. The bounded assumptions are the exact detection scope (which literal types count as static) and whether the existing message wording is kept, which is why this is P1 rather than P0; it is not P2 because the rule's own documented intent excludes the message-only alternative.
